reasoning: The glyph is the standard Material 'no_meeting_room' icon (an open doorway and frame cut by a diagonal slash), which fits tasks about releasing room bookings or closing off rooms. However, because the slash obscures the door's geometry, many viewers read the right-hand frame as a mug handle ('no drinks / no caffeine'), making it visually ambiguous though usable for both niche task families.
